messages.subject: Project Tempest - directors' duties advice note [PRIVILEGED]
messages.plaintextBody:
Directors,

Following our board call, I have sent through our advice note on your duties in the current circumstances. It is privileged - please keep it to the boards of Wexford Holdings and WCB and do not forward it on.

In short: while the group remains a going concern on the basis of the standstill and the proposed restructuring, the creditor duty is engaged, so you should hold regular minuted board meetings, monitor the 13-week cashflow weekly, take advice before any material decision, and avoid preferring any creditor. The note sets out the wrongful trading and misfeasance risks and the practical steps in full.

Do call me if you would like to talk any of it through.

Sarah

Whitfield Carter LLP, 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
